_comment: Copy this file to engagement_providers.json (gitignored) and fill in real endpoints. Entries are tried IN ORDER for each reel and rotated past whenever one responds with a rate-limit status code -- put your primary/cheapest provider first. This file is only a fallback for whatever yt-dlp's own metadata (view_count/like_count/comment_count) leaves null; with no file here at all, engagement still works using yt-dlp alone.
_verified: This first entry is a REAL, verified-working RapidAPI provider (instagram-api-fast-reliable-data-scraper) -- it takes Instagram's internal numeric media ID (not the URL), which {media_id} computes automatically from the reel URL's shortcode. Its response has views/likes/comments as flat top-level fields, confirmed via a live test call.
name: instagram_api_fast_reliable

_comment: A second endpoint, tried only if the first one above is rate-limited/exhausted. Different services shape their JSON differently -- response_paths is dot-notation into whatever this one returns; adjust it to match.
name: example_second_provider
